data.narrative:
Atmo is a Series A AI & Software company founded by Alex Levy and Johan Mathe that has raised $29.1M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comparable universe of five same-sector, same/adjacent-stage peers spanning private deployment-stage AI firms, with a broader reference set including one public comparable (Palantir, PLTR) and eight private peers such as Reflection AI, Scale AI, and Physical Intelligence.

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis uses the $29.1M total raised as a valuation proxy and applies a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical of Series A to subsequent stage transitions, yielding $58M. Peer-median analysis examines five direct comparables—Scale AI ($29.0B Series B), Reflection AI ($25.0B Series A), Physical Intelligence ($5.6B Series B), Black Forest Labs ($3.2B Series B), and Field AI ($2.0B Series B)—producing a median valuation of $5.6B, with a range spanning $2.0B to $29.0B.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $49M (low) to $6.4B (high), with a median of $2.8B. The wide dispersion reflects material uncertainty in stage-agnostic peer valuations; peers span two orders of magnitude despite sector and stage proximity. The stage-progression method yields a conservative floor consistent with recent capital deployment. Resolution of valuation range will depend on Atmo's demonstrated traction metrics relative to the peer cohort and the sectoral revaluation environment for frontier AI software.
